extDescription: See the glucose reading from your Dulce app on the Chrome toolbar. Link it with a code from your phone. Needs Dulce Pro.
linkStep2: Go to Settings › Chrome on a computer and scan this code, or type it.
linkNeedsPro: Needs Dulce Pro on the phone.
cantReach: Can't reach Dulce. Check your internet connection.
offline: Can't reach Dulce. Showing the last reading.
proRequiredText: The linked phone doesn't have Dulce Pro anymore. Renew it in the Dulce app to see the reading here.
signedOutText: The linked phone isn't signed in to its sensor account. Sign in again in the Dulce app.
waitingText: The reading shows here within a few minutes.
disclaimer: Not a medical device. Alerts stay on your phone.
unlinkHint: Also remove it on the phone: Settings › Chrome on a computer.
